title.zh: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000
title.en: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000

current_state.zh: The Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act in a 49-50 procedural vote, sending XRP down nearly 10% to $1.30 and dragging bitcoin toward $76,000 as every major token fell.
